topGear.revivalCatalystTooltip: Add tier-set versions of your raid gear to the comparison. Only considers pieces that would be an upgrade.

upgradeCompare.selectUpgradeable: Select at least one upgradeable item.
config.targetErrorHelp: Lower = more precise but slower. Default: 0.05%
config.parallelProfilesetsHelpAfter: to early Top Gear stages (4+ combos at target_error > 0.2), running profilesets concurrently instead of sequentially. Measured to be modestly faster on those stages; disabled at tighter precision where iteration parallelism wins. Uncheck to never emit the flag.
config.triageMaxBatchHelp: Streamed Top Gear only. Larger batches reduce repeated baseline and retention overhead, but Pause waits until the current batch completes.
dropFinder.bonusRollPickTier: Pick a raid or Mythic+ tier to see what a bonus roll could award.
dropFinder.upgradeEquippedTooltip: Raise your equipped gear to the same rank you are testing drops at, on each item’s own track, so the comparison starts level. Never lowers a piece that is already higher.
dropFinder.addVaultSocketTooltip: Sim every eligible drop as if it has a socket, filled with your preferred gem. Gear that already carries sockets is unaffected.
dropFinder.sourceFilterDesc: Switch off bosses you know have nothing for you — their drops leave the run, which shortens the sim.
dropFinder.fullPrecisionTooltip: Much slower: sims every drop to your target error. Off refines only the top few and leaves the rest as rough estimates.
gear.summaryNote: DPS compared to your current gear. Expected Value averages what each item a source drops is worth at its best; highlighted items are a 0.05% increase or better.
loot.alreadyOwnedReason: You already have this item on the same upgrade track or better, so a drop of it could not improve on what you wear.
consumables.sectionTooltip: Try other consumables against your Sim settings ones. Every mix multiplies the combinations.
consumables.hint: Your Sim settings consumables are the baseline. Pick alternatives to compare.
omnium.multiSelectHint: Pick more than one rune in a row to sim them all.
omnium.sectionTooltip: Your equipped folio is selected. Pick extra runes in a row to sim every combination of them alongside your gear.
